### Prayers
- Upgraded with a city already set? The one-time notification chooser now appears at launch instead of never — pick which prayers should call you and which sound, exactly as a fresh install does. - Prayer Settings › Notifications gains "Send test notification": a Dhuhr reminder five seconds out, with your Dhuhr sound, so a silent Mac can be diagnosed in one press. - The Tahajjud offset now reads as it works — "20 min before Fajr" instead of a bare negative number — and the −/+ steppers respond to taps that land on the glyph's edge, not only its centre.
### Risky Words
- The built-in list grew from 21 to 649 words across English, Arabic and Bengali — explicit terms, slurs and abuse, in Bangla script and romanized. Words whose innocent reading is ordinary content (animal names, anatomy, crime-report and religious-text vocabulary) are left out, so news, health and tafsir pages stay reachable; the insult phrases carry them instead.
### Fleet
- Organisation sign-in now talks to the production fleet. The question about pointing the Mac at a development server is gone.
